enter the code.

redeemSteps: Launch Weak Legacy 2 and let the server fully load.
press M or click the MENU button to open the menu.
find the Codes section.

games.name: Shindo Life
redeemSteps: Launch Shindo Life from the official Roblox page.
open the character Edit screen.
find the Enter-Code or YouTube Code field.
paste the complete case-sensitive code including its exclamation mark.
press Enter.

games.name: King Legacy
redeemSteps: Launch King Legacy from the official Roblox page.
select Menu below the health bar.
open the shop or settings panel shown by your current client.
scroll to the Enter Code field.
paste the case-sensitive code.
select Use.
